nodes.label: Community Tab Icon
nodes.description: White-on-transparent icon depicting a group of people (three figures) with a hand/support gesture below, representing community and social support. Used as the Community section icon in the app's tab bar or navigation.
nodes.visual_design: Outline-style white icon; three human silhouettes at top representing a group, a hand underneath suggesting support or giving; minimal line art on transparent background
nodes.purpose: Represents the Community section — a social/support area of the app where users can interact or get help
